fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Dade County and Miami Beach politics, including criticism of legislative representatives and discussion of upcoming city commissioner elections and the selection of a new city manager. Coverage addresses proposals and disputes over horse-racing legislation, talk of recalling Miami Beach mayor Newt Lummus, and debate over forming a separate Miami Beach county. Additional items include discussion of local welfare and unemployment claims, prohibition enforcement and alleged illicit liquor distribution, transportation notices (jitney route change), civic letters to the editor, and local news/columns such as “Little Geraldine.”
